text:
mara: mini WFH saga
I had to run ethernet across the ceiling because my router died and the only outlet was over the hallway. picture: https://imgur.com/a/ceiling-run (1 pic)
mara: used a small cable raceway and painted it to match the trim. looks... almost intentional. :sunglasses:
ben: that sounds delightfully committed. any spiders living in the raceway? :spider:
cleo: pro tip: use 3M command clips for light runs, they don't wreck paint and hold well.
mara: yep used clips. also labeled both ends "mara-net" so housemate doesn't unplug during movie nights.
ops-bot: Reminder: if you alter shared/common wiring, confirm building/landlord rules. See /wfh-policy.
mara: landlord gave a thumbs up over text. also ran a quick throughput test after the move:
```
speedtest-cli --simple
Ping: 20.4 ms
Download: 68.3 Mbit/s
Upload: 9.7 Mbit/s
```
mara: much better than the WiFi dead-zone. planning to tuck the AP behind a hanging plant for vibes.
ben: poll: best camouflage for a temporary AP? 1) Hanging plant 2) Picture frame 3) Shoe box 4) Towel fort
cleo: 1 for aesthetics, 3 for practicality.
andy: 2 is my go-to. frames are inconspicuous.
mara: will post after pic of the plant-camo. if it looks too artisanal, i'll accept mockery. :camera_with_flash:
ops-bot: Sticker eligibility: if thread gets >4 reactions submit /swag-request for a "Ceiling Cable Connoisseur" sticker.
mara: bravely accepting the title. thanks team for the tips!
